ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Child Care Funding Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent cases of child care funding fraud and follow the money to determine where the stolen funds are going.
questions: Where are the stolen funds going?
Who is behind the fraud schemes?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and bring those responsible to justice. By following the money, we can determine where the stolen funds are going and who is behind the scheme.
